    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))

    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap

        return -1000000.0 - peak * 1000.0

    pack = peak * 0.70
    headroom = (1.0 - peak) * 0.15

                    mem_after = float(target_node.mem_allocated + source_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
                    target_peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)

                    source_cpu = float(source_node.cpu_allocated) / float(max(source_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    source_mem = float(source_node.mem_allocated) / float(max(source_node.mem_capacity, 1))
                    source_peak = max(source_cpu, source_mem)

                    if target_peak < 0.85 and target_peak > source_peak:
                        out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, destination_pod.current_node))
                        moved_ids.append(source_pod.id)
                        moved = moved + 1
                        did_move = True

                if not did_move and moved < budget and destination_movable and not source_node.suspended:
                    cpu_cap2 = float(max(source_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    mem_cap2 = float(max(source_node.mem_capacity, 1))
                    cpu_after2 = float(source_node.cpu_allocated + destination_pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap2
                    mem_after2 = float(source_node.mem_allocated + destination_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap2
                    source_peak2 = max(cpu_after2, mem_after2)

                    dest_cpu = float(target_node.cpu_allocated) / float(max(target_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    dest_mem = float(target_node.mem_allocated) / float(max(target_node.mem_capacity, 1))
                    dest_peak = max(dest_cpu, dest_mem)

                    if source_peak2 < 0.85 and source_peak2 > dest_peak:
                        out.append(move_pod(destination_pod.id, source_pod.current_node))
                        moved_ids.append(destination_pod.id)
                        moved = moved + 1

    return out
